papers.title: EVA-Bench: A New End-to-end Framework for Evaluating Voice Agents
papers.abstract: Voice agents, artificial intelligence systems that conduct spoken conversations to complete tasks, are increasingly deployed across enterprise applications. However, no existing benchmark jointly addresses two core evaluation challenges: generating realistic simulated conversations, and measuring quality across the full scope of voice-specific failure modes.

papers.title: FlowCompile: An Optimizing Compiler for Structured LLM Workflows
papers.abstract: Structured LLM workflows, where specialized LLM sub-agents execute according to a predefined graph, have become a powerful abstraction for solving complex tasks. Optimizing such workflows is challenging due to the combinatorial design space over model choices, reasoning budgets, and workflow structures.

papers.title: LEAD: Length-Efficient Adaptive and Dynamic Reasoning for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large reasoning models tend to become increasingly verbose as their reasoning capabilities improve. These inflated Chain-of-Thought trajectories often exceed what the underlying problems require, wasting compute, latency, and context budgets. LEAD replaces static heuristics with online, self-adaptive mechanisms.

papers.title: FeatCal: Feature Calibration for Post-Merging Models
papers.abstract: Model merging combines task experts into one model and avoids joint training, retraining, or deploying many expert models. FeatCal uses a small calibration set to calibrate the merged model weights layer by layer in forward order, reducing feature drift.

papers.title: RealICU: Do LLM Agents Understand Long-Context ICU Data? A Benchmark Beyond Behavior Imitation
papers.abstract: Intensive care units generate long, dense and evolving streams of clinical information. RealICU is a hindsight-annotated benchmark for evaluating large language models under realistic ICU conditions, where labels are created after senior physicians review the full patient trajectory.

papers.title: BEACON: A Multimodal Dataset for Learning Behavioral Fingerprints from Gameplay Data
papers.abstract: BEACON is a large-scale multimodal dataset that captures diverse skill tiers in competitive Valorant gameplay, containing approximately 430 GB of synchronised modality data from 79 sessions across 28 distinct players.

papers.title: Retrieval from Within: An Intrinsic Capability of Attention-Based Models
papers.abstract: INTRA (INTrinsic Retrieval via Attention) is a framework where decoder attention queries score pre-encoded evidence chunks that are then directly reused as context for generation, unifying retrieval and generation and eliminating the retriever-generator mismatch typical of RAG pipelines.

papers.title: Federation of Experts: Communication Efficient Distributed Inference for Large Language Models
papers.abstract: FoE restructures the MoE block of a transformer layer into multiple MoE clusters. Each cluster is responsible for only one of the KV heads and expert parallelism is applied between those experts, completely eliminating all-to-all communication in single-node settings.

papers.title: An Empirical Study of Automating Agent Evaluation
papers.abstract: EvalAgent automates the end-to-end agent evaluation pipeline. Without domain-specific evaluation knowledge, frontier coding assistants achieve only a 30% execution success rate, showing that strong coding ability does not automatically translate to reliable agent evaluation.

papers.title: From Generalist to Specialist Representation
papers.abstract: This work studies identifiability of task-relevant specialist representations in a completely nonparametric setting, proving that structure between time steps and tasks is identifiable in a fully unsupervised manner.

cc_updates.body: Added terminalSequence field to hook JSON output so hooks can emit desktop notifications, window titles, and bells without a controlling terminal. Added CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_PREFER_HTTPS to clone GitHub plugin sources over HTTPS instead of SSH. Added ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID environment variable for workload identity federation. Added claude agents --cwd <path> to scope the session list to a directory. /feedback can now include recent sessions. Rewind menu: added Summarize up to here to compress earlier context. Auto mode permission dialog now explains when a permissions.ask rule caused the prompt. Background agents launched via /bg now preserve the current permission mode. Improved spinner feedback during long thinking periods.

Improved Agent tool subagent_type matching to accept case- and separator-insensitive values. Updated agent color palette. Fixed /goal silently hanging when disableAllHooks or allowManagedHooksOnly is set. Fixed a regression in settings hot-reload where symlinked settings files caused misattributed change events. Fixed claude --bg failing with connection dropped mid-request. Fixed background service startup failing on machines with enterprise endpoint security. Fixed remote managed settings not retrying on 401. Fixed /loop scheduling redundant wakeups.

Added agent view (Research Preview): a single list of every Claude Code session. Added /goal command: set a completion condition and Claude keeps working across turns until its met. Added /scroll-speed command to tune mouse wheel scroll speed. Added claude plugin details <name> to show a plugins component inventory. Added transcript view navigation shortcuts. Added hook args: string[] field (exec form). Added hook continueOnBlock config option for PostToolUse. MCP stdio servers now receive CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR in their environment.
